question: Of the two alfalfa silage groups, how many silos were in the group with the lower pH, and what acetic acid concentration did that group have?
rendered: According to the document, 49 silos were classified as the relatively well-fermented group (LPGood), which had a lower pH. The LPGood group had an acetic acid concentration of 11.27 ± 0.16 g/kg DM.
